newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk Petkim to pay dividend.
newsitem.headline: Turk Petkim to pay dividend.

text.p: Turkey's largely state-owned petrochemicals giant Petkim - Petrokimya Holding A.S. will distribute a 6,400 lira cash dividend per 1,000 lira nominal-valued share from its 1996 profits, the Istanbul Stock Exchange said.
It said the dividend payout totalling 19.2 trillion lira was approved at the company's annual meeting of shareholders and directors on Monday. The payout will begin on May 23.

Petkim's 1996 net profits were 24.45 trillion lira, up from 22.73 trillion in 1995. 96 percent of Petkim's capital is held by Turkey's privatisation agency OIB as the company is on the government's privatisation programme.
